data.title: Unit 1 : The Human Body
How much you know?
data.text: Click either RIGHT or WRONG for each of the following sentences.
Muscles are the framework of the body.
The joints of the hands and feet are movable.
For the body to be fit, we need to keep our muscles healthy.
If we had no bones, we would not be able to stand up.
The place where two muscles meet is called a joint.

feedback.rank1: Hmm... I'm sure you can do better!
